summary: This is a fiction excerpt in which Ms. McCavity debates Damian on a studio broadcast hosted by an ewok named Wickett. They argue about how much privacy and liberty to trade for security, and whether autonomous networks should decide federal investigations. Afterward the ewok thanks her for a law that let it obtain a body modification, and she says she only helped with it. Damian is losing the debate as the segment goes on.
one_line: A fiction excerpt from Book 10 where Ms. McCavity debates Damian on a talk show hosted by an ewok over surveillance, security, and autonomous networks.
key_facts: Ms. McCavity appears on a studio broadcast where she debates Damian while an ewok host named Wickett moderates.
Wickett asks Ms. McCavity: "But how much should we be willing to trade, Ms. McCavity?"
Ms. McCavity quotes Franklin: "Those willing to give up a little liberty for a little security deserve neither security nor liberty."
Ms. McCavity says autonomous networks are appropriate for advising people on the best way to get to the mall on a busy Saturday.
Ms. McCavity says autonomous networks should not be used to decide whom the FBI should open an investigation into.
Ms. McCavity says judges, grand juries and evidence are needed before investigating a private citizen who is considered innocent until proven guilty.
Ms. McCavity refers to lessons learned during the War on Terrorism and the Ashcroft witch-hunts.
Ms. McCavity asks whether people should trade grand juries and judges for ant-colonies, and whether a warrant should be issued by a simulated ant-hill.
Wickett says it has self-identified as an ewok since it was five years old.
Wickett says Lucasfilm would not license the surgery, so it went through every day feeling like a stranger in its body.
Wickett says it found a doctor willing to perform the surgery without permission after the law was enacted.
Ms. McCavity responds: "It wasn't my law, but I helped."
Damian is described as not looking good, having been on the ropes since the opening remarks.
The ewok kept interrupting Damian to let Ms. McCavity rebut.
